summary: W19 — the added Build load week (Adj #204, ~25 mi) and the last full week before the W20 deload. It carries the §10 5K-pace cut-down test Wed 8-26, which now arbitrates T alone: W18 validated the stepped 7:40–7:45 band on its first outing (Adj #291) and settled the I band at 7:00–7:15 outright (Adj #296), so the only open pace question is whether T's second consecutive sub-anchor RPE read means the band has more room. Cut-down validity rests on hitting the M and T miles on pace before the goal-pace mile (Adj #292). Fri runs the 2nd exposure of 5×1000m @ I, opened at 7:00 with 90 s jog recoveries. Mon's 70-min long is the week's entire easy fraction and carries the standing first-run-after Achilles read at ~40 h off Saturday's calf 365 dose. Four lift decisions fire across the two lift days: lat 170 and DB lateral back to 35 Sat, preacher 75 Tue, plus a load-or-set-count call on the new two-handed rope pushdown Tue.

days.note: The week's entire easy fraction — 9:15–10:30, conversation-gated, RPE 4–5; standing first-run-after Achilles read at ~40 h from the 8-22 calf sweep, not a gate (Adj #306).

Incline repeats 1×5 @ 160 + AMRAP @ 135 — ≥RIR 2 → 165, <5 reps = §5 miss #2 (Adj #285); preacher 75 FIRES (Adj #287); pushdown is a load-or-set-count call on the two-handed rope — 45–50 for four sets or 55 for three (Adj #304); DB lateral 35, rear-delt 145, crunch +10 hold.

days.session: §10 cut-down test — 1 mi M / 1 mi T / 1 mi @ goal 5K pace
days.note: Final mile at 6:55 reading RPE 8–9 passes; RPE 10 or can't sustain downgrades a tier. Arbitrates T alone now that I is settled (Adj #291/#296); validity rests on hitting the M (8:15–8:25) and T (7:40–7:45) miles on pace (Adj #292).

days.session: Off — mobility / walk, daily SI prehab

days.note: Open at 7:00, band 7:00–7:15, RPE 9 governs; recoveries JOGGED at 90 s. Smaller total dose than W18's 8×800m so the fast-end open stays correct (Adj #296/#298).

Lat 170 FIRES — front three under the 8 floor reverts 165 (Adj #301); DB lateral REVERTS 35 (Adj #302); crunch one more exposure at 13.2/+15 with the opener capped at 10 (Adj #305); calf holds 365 to finish the rebuild toward the 4×12 (Adj #306); row 80, preacher 60, fly 130 hold.
